info.name: LIVEKINDLY Content API (WordPress REST wp/v2) Discovery API

description.content:
LIVEKINDLY Collective publishes thelivekindlyco.com on WordPress, which exposes the WordPress REST API at https://thelivekindlyco.com/wp-json/. The wp/v2 namespace is anonymously readable and returns the company newsroom and LiveKindly Blog, corporate pages, the `brand` directory (Fry’s Family Food Co., Like Meat, Oumph!, The No Meat Company), the `partner` directory (PHW Group, RCL Foods, Ospelt, Coest), the `job` careers listings, the media library, taxonomies and a site-wide search endpoint as JSON.

This document was DERIVED mechanically by API Evangelist from the route-discovery document served at https://thelivekindlyco.com/wp-json/ on 2026-08-04 — every path, method and parameter below is taken verbatim from that descriptor. LIVEKINDLY does not publish an OpenAPI definition of its own, and this is not a product API: it is the content API the CMS exposes. Write operations exist on these routes but require authentication (WordPress Application Passwords over HTTP Basic).
